page_title: Gumloop: Build AI agents for work

summary.name: Gumloop
summary.one_liner: Gumloop is a multiplayer AI agent builder where teams create agents with any AI model and integration while IT controls access.
use_cases: Identify at-risk customer accounts and run save plays before renewal
Automate web tasks in a browser that has no API
Draft and triage email from an agent in your inbox
Answer data questions from a team chat channel
Run a Salesforce or HubSpot workflow through an agent
Let non-technical staff build and share agents across a company
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Gumloop as a platform for building AI agents that work across a company's tools. Agents can be built by one team member and shared with others, with permissions set for editing, viewing, or using them. Agents can be reached from Slack, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, iMessage, and a web chat, and can be triggered by events such as a meeting ending or a form submission. Agents can operate a real browser to click, type, and pull data from sites with or without an API, using a saved-login password vault, CAPTCHA handling, and handoffs to a human when a site needs sign-in. Sessions are recorded with audit logs, and the page lists features such as agent evaluations, an insights dashboard for spend, and connectors to Salesforce and HubSpot.
notable: Agents act in a real browser with a password vault that hides credentials from the agent
Session recordings and audit logs of every login, takeover, and handoff
Agents can be triggered by events and are reviewed and improved over runs
Admins control access while teammates build and share agents
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Some features such as the SDK, Salesforce tools, and specific models are described as recent additions and may vary by plan (not specified)
